description:
# ✨ Welcome Message
- Send a title and subtitle message or a chat message when a player joins the server
# ⚙️ Configuration (config.yml)
```yml
types:
  chat: false
  title: true
  actionbar: false
title:
  title: §2Welcome to the server!
  subtitle: Play your way
chat:
  message: §2Welcome to the server!
actionbar:
  message: §2Welcome to the server!
```
